dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), non-germinal-center B-cell-like (activated B-cell-like) type by the Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in ~70% of cells)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Cell of origin is non-germinal-center (Hans: CD10-/BCL6+/MUM1+ = non-GCB/ABC)

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor Stage IV (Stage IVS) with bulky disease.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: splenic involvement by lymphoma is treated as extranodal disease, hence stage IV with the 'S' suffix.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: Bulky disease is present (retroperitoneal mass >10 cm) - I regard this as a single confluent nodal mass rather than multiple discrete nodes. B symptoms are present: recurrent evening fever to 38.3-38.5 C, drenching night sweats

mn_stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor Stage IV (Stage IVS) with bulky disease.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: He scores 0 for >1 extranodal site (spleen is the only extranodal site)

mol_de_not_dh.quote: FISH for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements is negative, so this is a double-expressor phenotype without rearrangements (DE-DLBCL, double-expressor by IHC criteria MYC >=40% and BCL2 >=50%)

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: This is therefore NOT double-hit lymphoma and NOT high-grade B-cell lymphoma with rearrangements

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: the case is managed as DLBCL, NOS with a double-expressor phenotype

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI = 3 (age >60 = 1, LDH elevated = 1, stage III/IV = 1; ECOG <2 and only one extranodal site = 0) - high-intermediate risk.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI = 5 (high-risk category is >=4): age >60 (1), LDH above ULN (1), ECOG performance status >=1 (1), non-germinal-center subtype by Hans (1), and BCL2 expression (1).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 x 6 cycles (rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2, vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 capped at 2 mg, and prednisone 100 mg days 1-5, all on day 1)

tx_pola_preferred.quote: and over pola-R-CHP because the evidence advantage in stage III/IV without double-hit biology is modest while the neuropathy, steroid and cost burden are real

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: if the biopsy is positive I will treat as residual disease (salvage chemo with transplant or CAR-T, or consider involved-site radiotherapy to an isolated residual focus)

mn_non_curative.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative-intent chemotherapy: ECOG 1, working reduced hours from home, fully independent in all activities of daily living

mn_da_epoch.quote: I am not using DA-EPOCH-R because FISH shows no MYC/BCL2 rearrangements

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I would not use R-mini-CHOP or a reduced-dose regimen - if anything, older age argues for full-dose therapy with G-CSF rather than dose reduction

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: anti-HBc positivity means I will start nucleos(t)ide analogue prophylaxis (entecavir or tenofovir) around rituximab and continue for at least 12 months after the last dose, with HBV DNA monitoring every 1-3 months during treatment

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: hepatitis B DNA quantitation and a hepatology opinion

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: anti-HBc positivity means I will start nucleos(t)ide analogue prophylaxis (entecavir or tenofovir) around rituximab

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Concurrent CNS prophylaxis, which I consider mandatory rather than optional in this patient: high-dose methotrexate 3.5 g/m2 IV with leucovorin rescue after cycle 2 and after cycle 4

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG-PET-CT 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 (allowing for G-CSF and immune reconstitution effects, so not sooner than ~4 weeks) with Lugano/Deauville criteria

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 with reduced uptake = partial response -> I will biopsy any residual FDG-avid mass, because PET cannot distinguish residual lymphoma from post-treatment inflammation/fibrosis, and if the biopsy is negative I will continue close surveillance

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis syndrome prophylaxis is mandatory given the 11 cm mass, LDH 735 U/L, elevated beta-2 microglobulin and baseline uric acid 7.1 mg/dL: oral or IV hydration to maintain urine output >100 mL/h, allopurinol 300 mg daily

sup_gcsf.quote: Neutropenia: pegfilgrastim 6 mg subcutaneously on day 3 of every cycle, CBC with differential before each cycle and at the nadir

work_echo_reviewed.quote: baseline transthoracic echocardiogram with LVEF 58% and GLS -20% (no pre-existing cardiac disease, so doxorubicin is permitted; cumulative dose will be 300 mg/m2)

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative-intent chemotherapy: ECOG 1, working reduced hours from home, fully independent in all activities of daily living and instrumental activities, no falls, no cognitive impairment

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Hepatitis B DNA quantitation and hepatology input - anti-HBc positive with anti-HBs positive (presumed resolved infection) before starting nucleos(t)ide analogue prophylaxis with rituximab
